transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining today's readiness huddle. As you know, we have one Saturday mobile vaccination clinic available this month, and I'll be making the final site activation decision. Before I can approve either the Eastside Community Center or the Westside Library, I need each of you to report your requirements. I'd like to hear from public health nursing on clinical requirements, pharmacy logistics on supply requirements, and community outreach on access requirements. Let's get started — who would like to go first?

transcript.text: I'd like to share the clinical requirements from public health nursing. I received the updated allocation list from the county nurse coordinator this morning, and it records 31 children aged six months through four years in the Eastside service area. Per county policy, the Saturday session serving that group must use the pediatric mRNA formulation at Eastside Community Center. So from a clinical requirements standpoint, the site needs to be Eastside Community Center, and we need the pediatric mRNA formulation documented for that location.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thanks, Evan. From pharmacy logistics, I can report on the supply requirements. I've verified with facilities that the Eastside Community Center has a validated vaccine refrigerator with capacity for 80 doses at 2-8 degrees Celsius. Pharmacy policy also requires an opening temperature-log check at 08:00 before any doses are released at that location. So the cold chain capacity at Eastside can support the pediatric mRNA formulation, provided we document that 08:00 temperature check before dose release.

This supports strong community access at the Eastside location.
